fields.description:
## Objective

Build a record-triggered flow on Study Link Click that resolves the happy path: match or create the Player, resolve the Deal-Rep Assignment, then link or create a Sign-Up. Demo-grade only; the production flow with full review-branch handling is a separate story (BUILD-04).

## Implementation Requirements

* Record-triggered flow on Study_Link_Click__c, entry when Processing Status = New
* Player resolution: match on Player External Id, then Email; exactly one match links, zero matches creates a Player (record type Player)
* Deal-Rep Assignment resolution: match Rep External Id + Deal External Id where status = Active; exactly one match required
* Sign-Up resolution: link to an existing open Sign-Up (Status New/In Progress/Past Due/Flagged) for the same Player + Assignment, else create one with Status = New
* On success set Processing Status = Processed; on any other outcome set Review Required + a Review Reason and stop
* Name the flow with a POC prefix

## Acceptance Criteria

* Inserting a click creates/links Player and Sign-Up and sets Processed
* A repeat click for the same Player + Deal links to the existing open Sign-Up instead of creating a second one
* An unresolvable click is flagged Review Required with a reason, never errors

## Testing Notes

Three scenarios: new player, repeat click, unknown rep id.

## Out of Scope

All multi-match and error-path branch handling, async optimization (BUILD-04).

## Additional Notes

* This flow is replaced by BUILD-04; nothing else should depend on it.

---
